verdict.rationale: Autumn documents webhooks that fire on plan changes and an MCP server for billing tools. Nothing in the evidence shows failed-payment events, payment retry endpoints, or dunning outreach that an agent could monitor or drive. The plan-change webhooks and general MCP billing tools are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach
